prompt: Match each word to what it names in this course's lab.
hint: Real computer, software computer, and what sits between.

pairs.right: vm1, the computer made of software
QEMU, which makes the guest believe it has hardware
The management layer that virsh talks to

prompt: qemu-img made vm1.qcow2 with a size of 8G. How much of the host's disk did it take right away?
hint: qcow2 grows as it is written.

choices.text: 8 GiB, reserved at once
choices.why: That is a raw, fully allocated disk, not this one.

choices.text: 620M, a full copy of the base
Half of it, 4 GiB
Almost nothing
choices.why: Right. It grows only when the guest writes.

prompt: What does -b lab-base.qcow2 make the new disk?
hint: It starts from something without copying it.

choices.text: An overlay on that base
choices.why: Right. It holds only its own changes.

choices.text: A backup of the base, made in the background
A disk that can only be read
choices.why: The guest writes to it all the time.

choices.text: A second disk the guest sees as vdb

prompt: vm1 writes a file to its disk. Which file on the host changes?

choices.text: lab-base.qcow2 only
choices.why: Then every guest on that base would see the change.

choices.text: vm1.qcow2 only
choices.why: Right. The base is never written.

choices.text: Both, to keep them in step
Neither; it stays in memory
choices.why: A disk write reaches a file.
